observed_error: After resumption, Sol placed git status, four protected-ref readbacks and two exact-file metadata readbacks in one semicolon-composed PowerShell invocation. The combined process exited zero and showed the expected values, but it breached the one-readback-per-process prevention control established by AER-0429.
impact: No product source, worktree content, ref, provider call or candidate changed. The combined output is retained as incident evidence and is not used as the verifier-admission gate.
correction: Every verifier-admission readback is executed again as an independent process before dispatch. Remaining validation, staging, commit and readback operations use one process per gate.
